topic: Hit remote start and nothing happens — fob battery, fuse, or hood pin?
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Hit remote start and... nothing happens?
beats.visualPrompt: Exterior shot of a car in a driveway at dusk, engine off and dark, a key fob resting on a nearby ledge/railing in the foreground, no hand in frame, static camera, cool overcast light.

beats.narration: No engine sound, no dash lights, no confirmation flash — nothing.
beats.visualPrompt: Interior-through-windshield shot of a dark, unlit dashboard and instrument cluster, static camera, no ambient glow, subtle exterior reflection only.

beats.narration: One clue: it's usually a dead fob battery, a blown remote-start fuse, or the hood not latched all the way.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a key fob with its rear cover removed, coin-cell battery compartment visible and empty/exposed, resting on a workbench, slow push-in, no hands or tools visible in frame.

beats.narration: Most systems won't even try unless the hood's fully closed and the doors are locked first.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a vehicle hood latch/safety-pin mechanism, hood shown slightly ajar, dim garage lighting, static mounted camera.

beats.narration: Don't guess which one it is. A quick check can point to the actual cause.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a vehicle fuse box panel, one fuse slot illuminated, dim garage lighting, static mounted camera.

beats.narration: Worth checking before the cold snap hits. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo and CTA text composited in post, never AI-generated.
